In the old world, building a startup meant months of coding, hiring, and guessing.

Now you can validate ideas in hours using AI tools—if you’re using the right stack.

Most discussions about AI focus on job losses.

But one Indian startup is using AI to help people get jobs.

Apna is deploying multilingual interview bots and employability tools for India's 300+ million blue and grey-collar workers, many of whom lack resumes, LinkedIn profiles or access to formal hiring networks. (Source: BusinessLine)

The bigger opportunity may not be AI replacing workers; it may be AI helping millions enter the formal economy for the first time.
